name: trace_quotient_eq_trace_localization_quotient
statement: Algebra.trace (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ pS) (Ideal.Quotient.mk pS x) = (equivQuotMaximalIdeal p Rₚ).symm (Algebra.trace (Rₚ ⧸ maximalIdeal Rₚ) (Sₚ ⧸ pSₚ) (algebraMap S _ x))

name: Algebra.trace_quotient_eq_of_isDedekindDomain
statement: Algebra.trace (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ pS) (Ideal.Quotient.mk pS x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk p (Algebra.intTrace R S x)
